name: GXO Logistics Distribution Center - Aloha OR

fieldNotes.facilityMismatch: Roster address '3585 SW 198th Ave, Aloha OR 97007' resolves (correctly) to the Intel Aloha Campus - a semiconductor fabrication campus, NOT a standalone GXO distribution center. Multiple Waze/web sources confirm 3585 SW 198th Ave is Intel's Aloha Campus. GXO Logistics provides on-site contract logistics services for Intel at this campus, but there is no separable, auditable GXO distribution-center yard (dock bank, trailer drop yard, distribution truck gate) - it is an Intel fab campus.
fieldNotes.satelliteFindings: z16-z18 imagery shows large semiconductor fab buildings with extensive rooftop cleanroom mechanical equipment, employee parking, construction-laydown yards, and a stormwater pond, surrounded by Aloha residential neighborhoods. No conventional warehouse dock bank or trailer drop yard is visible.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Intel campuses are security-controlled; campus entrances have guard/security structures (visible at the east campus entrance). Recorded truckGate/guardShack true at low confidence as campus security gates - this reflects Intel campus access control, not a GXO distribution-center truck gate.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: No distribution-style dock bank visible; fab material handling is internal/controlled - banded NONE.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Multiple large fab buildings form a campus.
fieldNotes.recommendation: This roster entry should be flagged for human review - it is an Intel fab campus serviced by GXO, not a GXO distribution center with an auditable truck yard.
